THE MODEL — two tiny classes carry the whole structure
word: String — the full word, cached at the terminal node
HashMap children ⇒ unicode-safe, sparse (vs a 26-slot array) ✓
caching `word` avoids rebuilding it from the DFS path ✓
no topK field — that is the single upgrade that makes this scale

frequency and score kept SEPARATE ⇒ you can re-rank

immutable ⇒ safe to hand straight to the caller, no defensive copy
